policy.disambiguationRule: Area rows keep the wiki place name. Upgrade/content rows that currently clone a place name get role titles so planners can tell geography from reward/activity packages.

notes: Wiki disambiguation page Big Game Hunter points to Anachronia Big Game Hunter and Havenhythe Big Game Hunter — Anachronia BGH must not link to the bare Big_Game_Hunter page.
Ranch Out of Time is a redirect / also-known-as for the article Anachronia Dinosaur Farm.
Slayer Lodge is a player-built base-camp structure, not a separate overworld settlement, but has its own wiki location article.
Dream of Iaia is a dream instance entered from the Effigy Incubator laboratory (near Anachronia lodestone), not a pure surface landmark on the island plate.

areasAudit.summary: Sixth Archaeology dig site on Anachronia; 90 Archaeology + associate qualification. Main hub facilities sit in base camp; four permanent excavation sites (Crypt of Varanus 90, Observation outpost 101, Moksha ritual site 106, Xolo City 113+).

issues.detail: Upgrade list also contains exact name 'Orthen Dig Site' (category Archaeology dig-site hub) plus near-clone 'Orthen Dig Site full mastery (monolith + recipes)'.

upgradeRoleTitles: Orthen Dig Site full mastery (monolith power + recipes)

areasAudit.summary: Player-managed island hub after the Anachronia base camp tutorial. Structures include Town Hall, Storehouse, Sleeping Quarters, Spa, Hunter Lodge, Slayer Lodge, Player Lodge, bank chest, lodestone, remote totem access.
areasAudit.capitalizationNote: Wiki uses lowercase 'base camp' after Anachronia; catalog matches.

issues.detail: Upgrades include exact 'Anachronia base camp' and near-clone 'Anachronia base camp structure tier rewards'.
placeAnchors comment says 'base camp west' relative to other Anachronia anchors; UV cluster is fine for the region plate but does not model full island geography.

upgradeRoleTitles: Base camp structure tier rewards package

areasAudit.summary: Player-owned farm expansion on an island off the west coast of Anachronia. Wiki article title is Anachronia Dinosaur Farm; also known as Ranch Out of Time (ROoT). Update and music track still use Ranch Out of Time branding.

issues.detail: Area display name Ranch Out of Time is community/official branding and a wiki redirect target. Prefer keeping it as the planner display name with wikiCanonicalTitle Anachronia Dinosaur Farm, or switch area label to Anachronia Dinosaur Farm and list Ranch Out of Time as alias.
Upgrade 'Ranch Out of Time (Anachronia Dinosaur Farm)' clones the place name; content row 'Herby Werby / Ranch Out of Time' incorrectly merges Herby Werby with the ranch.

upgradeRoleTitles: Dinosaur Farm pens and bean market (ROoT)
Ranch Out of Time combat perks (King of Beasts / No Fear / Armoured Hide)

areasAudit.summary: Dream replica of Iaia after Extinction. Entered via hibernation pod in the Effigy Incubator laboratory (north of Anachronia lodestone / enriched pontifex shadow ring). Six passive skilling stations fed by base-camp resources.

issues.detail: Not an overworld settlement east of the island. Map pin is a planner convenience for Anachronia-associated access; true entry is Effigy Incubator lab. Keep under Anachronia region for League resource/access pressure, but do not imply a surface path on the east coast.
Upgrade list contains exact name 'Dream of Iaia' (passive multi-skill XP stations).

upgradeRoleTitles: Dream of Iaia skilling stations (base-camp resource XP)
Necklace of Salamancy (Dream of Iaia rare)

areasAudit.summary: Runecrafting altar for time runes in the Time Rune Temple. Surface ruins on the north-western coast of Anachronia. First entry needs 100 Runecrafting (unboostable) and an enchanted key from Making History or Meeting History to anchor the ruins; key not consumed thereafter.
areasAudit.capitalizationNote: Wiki title is 'Time altar' (lowercase altar). Do not retitle to 'Time Altar' unless wiki changes.

issues.detail: Upgrades include exact 'Time altar' and near-clone 'Time altar / 110 Runecrafting' (the latter conflates altar access with 110 RC spell/resource progression).

Catalog upgrade detail says requirements '100 Runecrafting, Enchanted key' which matches first-entry anchoring. Time-rune craft is 100 RC; 110 RC is a separate progression band for other products (e.g. catalysed elemental diamond uses Time altar among others) — keep split clear.

upgradeRoleTitles: Time altar access and time-rune craft
110 Runecrafting time-rune infrastructure (ring of imbuing pressure)

areasAudit.summary: Island-wide agility course / primary transit method. Seven sections; levels 30/50/70/85. Full lap needs 85 Agility. Rewards include codex pages for Double Surge / Double Escape.

issues.detail: Same string is area + content + upgrade. Violates area-vs-role separation hardest of any Anachronia place.

upgradeRoleTitles: Agility codex pages (Double Surge / Double Escape)

areasAudit.summary: Player-built structure at Anachronia base camp (north-east of Town Hall). Laniakea can be found here. Tiers: +1% / +3% / +6% damage on Anachronia; tier 3 adds Slayer helmet stand (helmet bonuses without worn stats/teleports).

issues.detail: Geographically inside Anachronia base camp, not a separate town. Still correct as a named planner pin and wiki location. Optional parent note: child of base camp.
Upgrade 'Slayer Lodge progression' is the correct role form; keep area as Slayer Lodge and upgrade as the tier package.

upgradeRoleTitles: Slayer Lodge tier progression (Anachronia damage + helmet stand)

contentAudit.summary: Hunter activity on Anachronia (from 75 Hunter / 55 Slayer). Nine dinosaur species, dragon mattock 1/101, terrasaur maul pieces from tier 3. Distinct from Havenhythe Big Game Hunter.

issues.detail: catalog content source.url is Big_Game_Hunter which is a disambiguation page (Anachronia BGH vs Havenhythe BGH vs Fremennik achievement). Must use Anachronia_Big_Game_Hunter.
Upgrades also include exact 'Anachronia Big Game Hunter' plus 'Big Game Hunter permanent unlock package' and 'BGH poison frog and spear weakness system'.

upgradeRoleTitles: BGH permanent unlock package (quick traps / marks path)
BGH poison frog and spear weakness system

contentAudit.summary: Correct wiki page, but content duplicates the area row.

issues.detail: Prefer single area row for place; content should be role-titled if kept (training/transit activity package).

contentAudit.proposedAction: either drop content row and keep area, or rename content to role title

contentAudit.summary: Boss on south-eastern Anachronia near Laniakea / Swamp Fortress. Ability codices (Greater Ricochet, Greater Chain, Divert) and boot upgrades are separate upgrade rows.

issues.detail: Display name Raksha is fine; wiki full title is Raksha, the Shadow Colossus. Prefer source URL to full title page.

contentAudit.summary: Boss trio accessed from spirit-grove area on Anachronia. Kind label 'bossing' is inconsistent with Raksha's 'boss' — cosmetic taxonomy only.

issues.detail: Normalize kind to 'boss' for both boss content rows.
